name: LeeWu AI - Gmail Maritime Discharge Order Intake & Telegram Kanban Dispatch

filters.q: subject:(discharging OR survey OR nomination OR descarcare OR cargo OR inspection OR WAN FU)

parameters.text:
=Analyze this incoming maritime cargo discharge email:

Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Sender: {{ $json.from.text }}
Body:
{{ $json.text || $json.snippet }}

Task: Determine if this is a Cargo Discharge Survey Nomination. If yes, extract in JSON format:
{
  "is_discharge_order": true,
  "vessel_name": "...",
  "imo_number": "...",
  "port": "PORT OF CONSTANTA SUD",
  "berth": "Berth 120",
  "client_name": "...",
  "cargo_description": "...",
  "total_tonnage_mt": 0,
  "bl_number": "...",
  "eta_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "special_instructions": "...",
  "priority": "URGENT|NORMAL|HIGH"
}

options.systemMessage: You are an expert maritime shipping agent AI. You extract structured cargo survey discharge orders from emails with 100% precision. Return valid JSON only.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "title": "{{ $json.vessel_name }} - Discharge Survey",
  "vessel_name": "{{ $json.vessel_name }}",
  "imo_number": "{{ $json.imo_number || '1072842' }}",
  "client_name": "{{ $json.client_name }}",
  "cargo": "{{ $json.cargo_description }}",
  "tonnage": "{{ $json.total_tonnage_mt }} MT",
  "bl_number": "{{ $json.bl_number || 'B/L PENDING' }}",
  "berth": "{{ $json.berth || 'Berth 120' }}",
  "port": "{{ $json.port || 'Port of Constanta Sud' }}",
  "stage": "gmail_intake",
  "priority": "{{ $json.priority || 'NORMAL' }}",
  "source": "Google Gmail AI",
  "email_sender": "{{ $('Gmail Trigger (New Survey Nominations)').item.json.from.text }}"
}

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO public.surveys (ref_no, vessel_name, imo_number, survey_type, status, port, berth, client_name, cargo_description, total_weight_kg)
VALUES (
  'SRV-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || SUBSTRING(MD5(RANDOM()::TEXT), 1, 4),
  '{{ $json.vessel_name }}',
  '{{ $json.imo_number || '1072842' }}',
  'DISCHARGING SURVEY',
  'AWAITING_REVIEW',
  '{{ $json.port || 'PORT OF CONSTANTA SUD' }}',
  '{{ $json.berth || 'Berth 120' }}',
  '{{ $json.client_name }}',
  '{{ $json.cargo_description }}',
  {{ ($json.total_tonnage_mt || 11) * 1000 }}
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
